The '''Worxer system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Worxer]].
